design_grounds: A003 keeps the endpoint-prediction clock of R02_v3 and only removes the detached element-matching cost (0.5 -> 0.0), so the 20-point support, window, dose and native protocol stay identical and the clock representation itself is tested before any element-cost contribution. R02_v3 already shows the endpoint representation carries a higher best_qualified_pic50 (8.6994) and U_tau (0.01129) than the fixed-clock R15_V3_COMPATIBLE (8.5901, 0.00910), while its mean_all_pic50 (7.6187) is lower and n_above_target is 0 in both, so this is a tail-only probe, not a mean-improvement claim. The ancestor record supplies both the actual current world A and the same-forward teacher predicted endpoint world A as distinct observables, and the selection_trend fixes the terminal local points with current-time teacher coordinates used only for correspondence; the component_response confirms the run executed with no SMC, no affinity gradient, no extra forwards and zero typed/charge weight, so no chemistry module is being asserted. The element_layout limits state that carbon-dominated accuracy is not N placement accuracy and that terminal labels are retrospective comparators, so no early chemical role is claimed.
falsifier: On the same 20-point F_b011_s030__reference support, if A003's terminal best_qualified_pic50 does not exceed the fixed-clock R15_V3_COMPATIBLE value of 8.590141296386719, or n_above_target remains 0 with no tail above that value, the endpoint-clock representation hypothesis is falsified; if A003 is indistinguishable from the element-cost 0.2/1.0 variants on the tail, the tail cannot be attributed to the clock representation rather than element-matching cost.
